summary.intent: Add unit tests to ipns.service.ts and shares.service.ts to bring patch coverage above the 80% threshold and fix a global branch coverage failure (75.57% vs 78% threshold).
summary.outcome: Added targeted tests covering error paths and edge cases in both services; global branch coverage rose to 78.43%, all 117 tests pass, and the changes were committed and pushed.

repo: Coverage is enforced at two levels: per-file patch coverage (80% threshold via Codecov) and global branch coverage (78% threshold).
IpnsService injects SharesService (for findActiveWriteShare), so unit test modules must provide a mock for SharesService.
The monorepo is under apps/api/src with co-located spec files (*.service.spec.ts next to *.service.ts).
shares.controller.ts also had low patch coverage (33.33%) but was not addressed in this session.

code.finding: Had 6 missing + 1 partial branch before tests; coverage went from 80.72% to 84.33% branches after adding error-path tests.
Uncovered lines were in updatePermission error paths (lines 367, 371, 380) and findActiveWriteShare (line 401); coverage went from 88.52% to 93.44% branches.
Required adding a mockSharesService variable and importing ForbiddenException and NotFoundException to cover the new error paths.
Required adding BadRequestException import to cover updatePermission validation error paths.

workflow: Codecov PR comments are the most direct way to identify exactly which lines are missing coverage — faster than running coverage locally.
Checking CI logs for both patch coverage and global branch coverage thresholds separately helps isolate which metric is failing.
Running affected tests locally before pushing confirms all tests pass and gives updated per-file coverage numbers.

friction: Global branch coverage drop (75.57%) was caused by new code added elsewhere, not by the files the user asked about — required investigation before the real gap was identified.
The IpnsService unit test module was missing a SharesService mock, which had already caused a prior CI failure and required iterative fixes.
Multiple read/edit cycles were needed on ipns.service.spec.ts to add the mock variable, then the tests, then the missing imports — these could have been batched.
open_items: shares.controller.ts patch coverage is only 33.33% (1 missing + 3 partials) — not addressed in this session and may still fail Codecov patch threshold on future PRs.
Global branch coverage is passing by a slim margin (78.43% vs 78% threshold); any new untested code could push it below the threshold again.
